name: PulseChain — Unified Epidemiological Signal Detection Engine v3.0

parameters.query: SELECT source, region, AVG(signal_value) as mean_value, STDDEV(signal_value) as std_dev, COUNT(*) as sample_count FROM signal_events WHERE source = '{{ $json.source }}' AND metadata->>'region' = '{{ $json.region }}' AND ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY source, region LIMIT 1;

values.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ region: $json.region, region_name: $json.region_name, z_score: $json.z_score, is_anomaly: $json.is_anomaly, detection_method: $json.detection_method }) }}

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ region: $json.region, region_name: $json.region_name, signals: $json.signals, prior: 0.02, observed_values: $json.observed_values, explain: true, forecast_spread: true, horizon_days: 14 }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM alert_dispatches WHERE status = 'sent' AND sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' LIMIT 20;

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ routing_key: $vars.PAGERDUTY_ROUTING_KEY || 'demo-key', event_action: 'trigger', payload: { summary: 'PulseChain SLA breach: ' + $json.count + ' alerts unacknowledged', severity: 'warning', source: 'pulsechain-sla-monitor', timestamp: $json.checked_at } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ routing_key: $vars.PAGERDUTY_ROUTING_KEY || 'demo-key', event_action: 'trigger', payload: { summary: 'PulseChain ' + ($json.severity || 'error').toUpperCase() + ': ' + ($json.error_message || 'Unknown error').substring(0,100), severity: $json.severity || 'error', source: 'pulsechain', component: $json.workflow_name } }) }}

meta.description: PulseChain Unified Epidemiological Signal Detection Engine v3.0 — FIXED: Kafka uses credentials instead of env brokers; Postgres uses executeQuery for baselines; IF nodes upgraded to typeVersion 2 with new conditions schema; $env replaced with $vars for PagerDuty key; crypto.createHash replaced with pure-JS hash; all API calls use sendBody instead of deprecated jsonParameters; typeVersion 2.5 for all Postgres insert nodes with proper schema/table selectors.
